title: delphinium virescens subsp. penardii
intro: Delphinium virescens subsp. penardii, commonly known as  Alpine Delphinium, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Ranunculaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate conditions such as wounds, infections, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Delphinium include antioxidant, antiviral, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for wound healing and infection treatment. The bioactive constituents of Delphinium virescens subsp. penardii include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
